supportedCases.questionText: My boss attempts fail after the first movement-heavy phase. Which observed build constraint should I test before replacing gear?

inputs.buildDescription: Player-supplied skill, passive, item, defense, flask, and ten-attempt observation summary; no inspectable export or live-price evidence attached
inputs.observedProblem: Eight of ten attempts end during the same movement-heavy phase; damage uptime resumes slowly after repositioning
inputs.budget: 50 Divine maximum; no current item price may be inferred

supportedCases.answerFocus: Determine whether the supplied observations support a paid bottleneck diagnosis; refuse if the missing inspectable build or encounter evidence prevents prioritized repairs.

supportedCases.questionText: Produced ore accumulates at the work area while nearby storage stays unchanged. Which handoff should I test first?

inputs.serverType: Dedicated server with no production-changing mods reported
inputs.currentGoal: Move produced ore into storage during one twenty-minute controlled observation
inputs.baseOrProgressionState: Player records work-area ore rising from 40 to 120 while destination storage remains at 200; assignments and layout stay unchanged
inputs.observedProblem: Production increases but the recorded destination storage does not

supportedCases.answerFocus: Identify the observed production-to-storage handoff as the first measured bottleneck, without claiming an unverified pathing or simulation mechanic.

supportedCases.questionText: My crafting queue remains at 100 units and the input stack does not change during a player-present test. What should I isolate next?

inputs.serverType: Single-player world with no work-speed mods reported
inputs.currentGoal: Start and measure one fixed crafting queue
inputs.baseOrProgressionState: Queue begins and ends at 100 units over fifteen minutes; input stack and output storage also remain unchanged; player keeps layout and assignments fixed
inputs.observedProblem: The recorded queue never begins consuming its supplied input

supportedCases.answerFocus: Treat queue start as the observed bottleneck and propose one-variable assignment and station-state tests without inventing worker-suitability mechanics.

supportedCases.questionText: Crops increase during my test but the next processing input stays at zero. Where should I focus the next observation?

inputs.serverType: Private co-op host with no production-changing mods reported
inputs.currentGoal: Move one measured crop batch into the next processing step
inputs.baseOrProgressionState: Crop inventory rises by 80 during thirty minutes while the recorded downstream input remains zero; no layout or assignment change is made
inputs.observedProblem: The measured upstream output never appears in the next recorded input

supportedCases.answerFocus: Diagnose only the observed inter-stage transfer gap and give a controlled handoff test; do not assert a specific game mechanic as the cause.

supportedCases.questionText: Items on the collection area rise while storage remains flat. How do I test whether collection is the first bottleneck?

inputs.serverType: Dedicated server with the same settings across both observations
inputs.currentGoal: Clear one measured collection batch into storage
inputs.baseOrProgressionState: Ground or collection-area count rises from 10 to 55 while destination storage stays at 300 during a twenty-minute player-present observation
inputs.observedProblem: Collected output accumulates before the recorded storage handoff

supportedCases.answerFocus: Identify collection-to-storage as the first observed gap, then define a matched test that changes only the handoff assignment or route condition.

supportedCases.questionText: Two bases use the same observation window, but only Base A produces output. What is the safest comparison plan?

inputs.serverType: Dedicated server; both bases observed by the same player account
inputs.currentGoal: Explain the measured difference without changing multiple variables
inputs.baseOrProgressionState: Base A adds 60 units in thirty minutes; Base B adds zero; the player has not yet matched assignments, layout, storage, and travel conditions
inputs.observedProblem: The two bases produce different recorded deltas under an incompletely matched comparison

supportedCases.answerFocus: Name the unmatched comparison as the current bottleneck and prioritize a one-variable matched test rather than inventing why Base B stops.

supportedCases.questionText: Output stops after storage reaches 95 of 100 recorded slots. How should I verify whether capacity is the first constraint?

inputs.currentGoal: Maintain output through one additional controlled batch
inputs.baseOrProgressionState: Recorded output increases until destination storage reaches 95 of 100 tracked slots, then remains unchanged for the next ten minutes
inputs.observedProblem: The output stop correlates with the recorded destination nearing capacity

supportedCases.answerFocus: Treat capacity only as a correlation, define a matched before-and-after storage-space test, and avoid asserting undocumented storage behavior.

supportedCases.questionText: Most of my upgrade session is spent traveling for one missing material. What should I change before farming more?
